description: A directory as the inventory source. Files are read in sorted (byte) order, recursing into subdirectories; hidden entries, group_vars/, host_vars/, vars_plugins/ and the ignored extensions are skipped. Only the source directory's own group_vars/host_vars load (not those of nested directories). VERSION-DEPENDENT: 2.18.8 ignores '.ini' files in directory walks (its default inventory_ignore_extensions contains '.ini'), 2.21.4 does not.
notes: With an explicit inventory_ignore_extensions both versions agree (the setting replaces the whole default list, so .txt, .retry and .ini are read again).
An ignored extension only affects directory walks: '-i inventory/README.md' parses the file.
